newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-UHISLIISING AND POHJALIISING TO MERGE.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-UHISLIISING AND POHJALIISING TO MERGE.

text.p: Uhisliising, a subsidairy of Uhispank , is to merge with the former Pohja-Eesti Pank's leasing arm, Pohjaliising, Uhisliising said on Tuesday.
The board of Uhisliising decided on Monday in favour of the merger, the leasing company said in a statement.
"It is possible with the two firms' merger that costs will be reduced and profits increased," Marek Puidak Uhisliising's board chairman said.
Uhisliising's balance sheet volume in April was 510 million kroons and Pohjaliising's balance sheet volume was 141 million kroons, the leasing company said.
Together the two firms will hold 19.3 percent of the Estonian market.
Uhispank and Pohja-Eesti Pank recently completed their merger process.
